sentences.text: Hello, everyone. Welcome to the Slow English podcast. My name is Emili. In this podcast,
we speak very slowly. We use easy English. We repeat words and ideas. Today, we travel
to Europe. We go to Spain. Our city today is Granada. Granada is historic. Granada is
warm. Granada is full of culture and beauty. Please relax. Please listen slowly.
Let's begin our journey together. Part 2. Spain and Europe. Spain is a country in
southern Europe. It has a long history. It has many cultures. Spain has mountains.
Spain has beaches. Spain has old cities. People know Madrid and Barcelona. But today
we visit Granada. Granada is not very big, but Granada is very important. It is full
of stories. Part 3. Where is Granada? Granada is in the south of Spain. It is in a
region called Andalusia. The city is near mountains. These mountains are called the
Sierra Nevada. In winter, the mountains have snow. In summer, the city is warm.
Granada is between nature and history. This makes it very special. Part 4. Weather and
seasons. Granada has four seasons. Summer is hot and sunny. People rest in the
shade. Winter is cooler. Sometimes it is cold at night. Spring is beautiful. Flowers
grow everywhere. Autumn is calm and soft. Life feels slow and peaceful. People change
their life with the seasons. Part 5. A city with deep history. Granada has a very long
history. Many people lived here before. Romans lived here. Muslims lived here.
Christians lived here. Each group left something. Buildings tell stories. Streets
remember the past. Granada is a city of many layers. Part 6. The Alhambra Palace.
Granada is famous for the Alhambra. The Alhambra is a palace. It is very old and
very beautiful. The walls are red. The gardens are green. Water flows quietly. People
visit the Alhambra every day. They walk slowly. They feel peace and wonder. Part 7.
The Albaison neighborhood. Granada has an old area called Albaison. The streets are
narrow. The houses are white. People walk uphill. They stop and look around. From
the past is alive. Part 8. Daily life in Granada. Daily life in Granada is relaxed.
People wake up slowly. They work and study. They meet friends. In the afternoon,
people rest. In the evening they go out. Life happens in the streets. Life feels
social and warm. Part 9. Food and Tapas. Granada is famous for Tapas. Tapas are
small dishes. When you buy a drink, you often get food for free. People eat
together. They talk and laugh. Food is simple and tasty. Eating is a social moment.
Part 10. Students and youth. Granada is a student city. There is a big university.
Students come from many countries. They study and enjoy life. Young people bring
energy. Cafes are full. Streets are alive. Because of students, Granada feels young
and fresh. Part 11. Nature and views. Nature is very close to Granada. Mountains
are nearby. People go hiking. People enjoy the views. You can see the city from
above. You can see history and nature together. The air feels fresh. The view
feels wide and open. Part 12. Feeling. Culture. And goodbye Granada is a city of
history, palaces, mountains, students, and slow life. It is warm. It is deep. It is
